form.label: l2t - WinEVTX Analysis
form.description: Enhanced analysis of Windows Event Log data from log2timeline output

input.label: Host Filter
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | stats count by host

input.label: Windows Event Source
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | stats count by winevent_source | sort -count

input.label: Event ID
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | stats count by event_id | sort -count

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | stats dc(event_id)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | sort -_time | head 1 | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" ctime(_time) as recent_event | table recent_event

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | timechart span=30m count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | stats count by winevent_source

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | stats count by event_id

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | eval category=case( match(winevent_source, "Security"), "Security", match(winevent_source, "System"), "System", match(winevent_source, "Application"), "Application", match(winevent_source, "Setup"), "Setup", match(winevent_source, "Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell"), "PowerShell", match(winevent_source, "BITS"), "Background Tasks", match(winevent_source, "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices"), "Remote Desktop", match(winevent_source, "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"), "Sysmon", match(winevent_source, "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender"), "Windows Defender", true(), "Other" ) | stats count by category | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | rex field=message "Level: (?<severity>\w+)" | eval severity=case( isnull(severity), "Information", severity="", "Information", true(), severity ) | stats count by severity | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | timechart count by event_id limit=10

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | eval hour=strftime(_time, "%H"), dow=strftime(_time, "%w") | stats count by hour dow | sort dow hour

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source="Security" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | eval security_category=case( event_id="4624" OR event_id="4625", "Authentication", event_id="4720" OR event_id="4722" OR event_id="4723" OR event_id="4724" OR event_id="4725" OR event_id="4738" OR event_id="4740" OR event_id="4767" OR event_id="4781", "Account Management", event_id="4648" OR event_id="4672", "Privilege Use", event_id="4688", "Process Execution", event_id="4698" OR event_id="4702", "Scheduled Task", event_id="5140" OR event_id="5145", "Share Access", true(), "Other" ) | stats count by security_category, event_id | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source="Security" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=4624 OR event_id=4625 | eval status=case( event_id="4624", "Success", event_id="4625", "Failure" ) | timechart span=30m count by status

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source="Security" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=4624 OR event_id=4625 | rex field=message "Account Name:\s+(?<username>[^\s]+)" | stats count by username | sort -count | head 10

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | eval is_suspicious=case( (winevent_source="Security" AND (event_id="1102" OR event_id="4672" OR event_id="4720" OR event_id="4740" OR event_id="4778" OR event_id="7045")), "High", (winevent_source="System" AND (event_id="7045" OR event_id="7040")), "Medium", (winevent_source="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational" AND (event_id="4103" OR event_id="4104")), "Medium", (winevent_source="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" AND (event_id="1" OR event_id="11" OR event_id="12" OR event_id="13")), "Medium", 1==1, "Low" ) | where is_suspicious=="High" OR is_suspicious=="Medium" | eval reason=case( event_id=="1102", "Security Log Cleared", event_id=="4672", "Admin Privileges Assigned", event_id=="4720", "User Account Created", event_id=="4740", "User Account Locked Out", event_id=="4778", "Remote Desktop Session", event_id=="7045", "Service Installation", event_id=="7040", "Service Change", event_id=="4103", "PowerShell Command", event_id=="4104", "PowerShell Script Block", event_id=="1", "Process Creation", event_id=="11", "File Creation", event_id=="12", "Registry Change", event_id=="13", "Registry Value Set", true(), "Other" ) | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" ctime(_time) as event_time | table event_time, host, winevent_source, event_id, reason, is_suspicious, message | sort -event_time

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | rex field=message "Provider Name: (?<provider>[^,\s]+)" | stats count by host, winevent_source, event_id, provider | sort -count | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" host=$hostFilter$ | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | search event_id=$event_id$ | eval category=case( match(winevent_source, "Security"), "Security", match(winevent_source, "System"), "System", match(winevent_source, "Application"), "Application", match(winevent_source, "Setup"), "Setup", match(winevent_source, "Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell"), "PowerShell", true(), "Other" ) | rex field=message "Provider Name: (?<provider>[^,\s]+)" | table _time, category, winevent_source, event_id, provider

input.label: event_id
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | stats count by event_id | sort -count

input.label: source
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | stats count by winevent_source | sort -count

table.title: list of all the fields extracted for l2t:winEVTX

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | fieldsummary | table field count | sort -count | dedup field
